summary: Q32 Bio Inc. filed an 8-K to announce positive 36-week topline results from Part B of its SIGNAL-AA clinical trial for bempikibart in alopecia areata. The press release furnished under Item 7.01 details open-label efficacy data including a 35.3% mean SALT score reduction. No transaction, corporate action, or special situation is involved; the filing is a routine disclosure of clinical trial results, not a corporate event.
